Drone fragment of unknown origin washes ashore at Saturn beach, Romania

14 August 2026 · Saturn beach

Aerial-drone fragment; origin unresolved

On the afternoon of 14 August 2026 waves carried a fragment of an aerial drone onto Saturn beach in Constanța County, on the Romanian coast. Tourists alerted the authorities, and access to the area was restricted while the object was examined.

Who launched the drone, and what type of drone the fragment came from, has not been established. Romanian reporting on the find also covered fragments found at Costinești, but no link between the two finds has been established.

Specialists reported that the fragment contained no pyrotechnic elements. It was examined and recovered, and no injuries were reported.
